title: 第十五章 上门第十六章 青石帮的威胁
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
残冬将尽，外城的风依旧带着料峭的寒意，卷着地上半化不化的积雪，打着旋儿撞在归一武馆的大门上。
这天，正好是林家资助这批少年入武馆的整一个月。
演武场上的晨霜还没有化尽，林家的管家就带着人来了。
手里拎着沉甸甸的银袋，挨个给武馆的众人发这个月的月例。
轮到秦苏的时候，管家递过来一个布包，里面是五两银子，分量压手。
秦苏掂了掂，这里面，有三两是他身为丙下根骨的基础月钱，剩下二两，是从王浩和刘间的份额里划过来的。
没错，就算他们已经将五行归元桩入门了，林家还是没有把这一两银子划到他们那边，除非他们比秦苏先成为武者，才有可能。
他把银子贴身收好，心中对这笔银子也有了盘算。
这个月武馆的肉食份额，需要二两银子才能续上，剩下三两，加上上个月还有二两银子剩余，手里一共五两现银。
吴慕秋的父亲，也就是秦苏的老丈人，是拉车送菜的，常年积劳，正好给他送一份药膳补补身子，再拿二两给吴慕秋，万一有什么事情，也能应急。
打定主意，秦苏没等武馆闭馆，就和宋福打了声招呼，拿着刚买的药膳，出了武馆，朝着吴家的巷子走去。
傍晚的外城，飘着糙米和腌菜的味道，偶尔能听见妇人喊孩子回家的声音。
可秦苏刚拐进吴家所在的巷子，就听见了吴慕秋的喊叫，声音尖厉。
秦苏心头猛地一紧，脚步瞬间加快，几乎是跑着往前冲。
终于能看见吴家，眼前的景象让他眼底的戾气瞬间翻涌上来。
吴家的木门被青石帮的混混死死撑住，张大强正用肩膀狠狠撞着门，木门吱呀作响，门栓已经被撞得变形，眼看就要被撞开。
他嘴里还不干净地骂着，污言秽语不断往外喷。
“吴丫头，你别给脸不要脸！我们帮主看上你，是你的福气！”
张大强又狠狠地撞了一下门，唾沫横飞，“跟着秦苏能有什么前途，连自己都顾不了，跟着他就是一辈子喝西北风！”
“我们帮主可是暗劲武者，在安陆县外城谁敢不给他面子？”

“你嫁过去，就是帮主夫人，顿顿有肉有汤，不比跟着秦苏强？赶紧开门，不然等我们撞开门，可就没这么好说话了！”
门里传来的是吴慕秋的声音，声音颤抖，十分害怕：“你们滚！光天化日之下强抢民女，不怕县衙抓你们吗！”
“县衙？”张大强嗤笑一声，笑得满脸乱颤，“在外城，我们帮主的话，比县衙还好使！你喊破喉咙也没用，今天，你必须跟我们走！”
说罢，他往后退两步，铆足了劲就要往门上撞。
“住手！”
秦苏的怒喝从巷口传来，张大强动作一顿，转头看过来，见是秦苏，脸上立刻露出了戏谑的笑，停了下来。
“我当是谁，原来是秦公子。”张大强抱着胳膊，上下扫了秦苏一眼，满脸不屑，“怎么？心疼你的小媳妇了？我还以为你缩在武馆里，不敢出来了呢。”
秦苏快步走到门前，将两个抵着门的混混一把推开，挡在吴家门前。
“张大强，你别欺人太甚！”
“欺负你又怎么了？”张大强吐了一口唾沫，逼近秦苏，“秦苏，别以为靠着林家进了武馆，练了几天，就了不起了，我们帮主想要的人，你也敢拦？”
话音落下，他身后的两个混混也围了上来，一脸凶相地盯着秦苏
秦苏没有退，这一个月的苦练，早已不是当初那个连自保都难的打更人了。
他冷冷地看着张大强，“我再说一遍，带着你的人滚！”
“嘿，你小子还敢嘴硬！”张大强瞬间火了，怒吼一声，挥着砂锅大的拳头就朝着秦苏的脸上砸过来。
他一身蛮力，常年街头打架，这一拳又快又狠，带着风。
秦苏脚下不动，身形侧身一拧，避开了他的拳头。
不等张大强收势，他手肘顺势一顶，狠狠撞在张大强的胸口。
content_en:
Winter is coming to an end, and the wind in the outer city is still chilly, rolling up the half-melted snow on the ground, swirling and hitting the gate of Guiyi Martial Arts Hall.
This day happened to be the entire month that the Lin family sponsored these young people to enter the martial arts gym.
The morning frost on the martial arts field had not yet melted away when the Lin family's housekeeper came with people.
Carrying a heavy silver bag in his hand, he distributed this month's monthly routine to everyone in the martial arts hall one by one.
When it was Qin Su's turn, the housekeeper handed over a cloth bag containing five taels of silver, which was heavy on his hand.
Qin Su weighed it up, and found that 3 taels of it were his basic monthly salary as a subordinate of Bing, and the remaining 2 taels were transferred from Wang Hao and Liu Jian's shares.
That's right, even if they had already started the Five Elements Guiyuan Stake, the Lin family still didn't transfer this tael of silver to them. This was only possible if they became warriors before Qin Su.
He kept the money close to his body and had a plan in mind for the money.
This month's meat quota for the martial arts hall requires two taels of silver to renew, leaving three taels left. In addition to the remaining two taels of silver from last month, there is a total of five taels of silver in hand.
Wu Muchiu's father, Qin Su's father-in-law, was a cart driver and had been working hard all year round, so he just gave him a medicinal meal to replenish his health, and gave Wu Muchiu two taels in case anything happened.
After making up his mind, Qin Su said hello to Song Fu before the martial arts hall closed. He took the medicinal food he just bought, left the martial arts hall and walked towards the alley of Wu's house.
In the evening in the outer city, there is the smell of brown rice and pickled vegetables, and occasionally you can hear the voice of a woman calling her children home.
But as soon as Qin Su turned into the alley where Wu's house was, he heard Wu Muchiu's shrill voice.
Qin Su's heart suddenly tightened, and his pace instantly quickened, almost running forward.
Finally he could see the Wu family, and the scene in front of him made the anger in his eyes surge up instantly.
The wooden door of Wu's house was held tightly by the gangsters from the Qingshi Gang. Zhang Daqiang was hitting the door hard with his shoulder. The wooden door creaked, and the door bolt had been deformed by the impact, and was about to be knocked open.
He was cursing incessantly, and kept spitting out obscene words.
"Girl Wu, don't be so shameless! It's your blessing that our gang leader likes you!"
Zhang Daqiang banged the door hard again, spitting everywhere, "What kind of future can I have by following Qin Su? I don't even care about myself. If I follow him, I will drink the northwest wind for the rest of my life!"
"Our gang leader is an Anjin warrior. Who dares not to give him face in the outer city of Anlu County?"
"If you marry, you will be the gang leader's wife. You will have meat and soup every time. Isn't it better than following Qin Su? Open the door quickly, or we won't be able to talk so easily when we open the door!"
What came from the door was Wu Muchiu's voice, which was trembling and very frightening: "Get out of here! You are robbing women in broad daylight. Aren't you afraid that the county government will arrest you!"
"County government office?" Zhang Daqiang sneered, his face trembling with laughter, "In the outer city, our gang leader's words are more effective than the county government office! It's no use shouting that your throat is broken. Today, you must follow us!"
After saying that, he took two steps back and was about to hit the door with all his strength.
"Stop!"
Qin Su's angry shouts came from the alley. Zhang Daqiang paused and turned around. When he saw it was Qin Su, he immediately showed a joking smile on his face and stopped.
"Who do I think he is? It turns out to be Mr. Qin." Zhang Daqiang crossed his arms and glanced at Qin Su with disdain on his face, "What? Are you feeling sorry for your little wife? I thought you were huddled in the martial arts gym and didn't dare to come out."
Qin Su walked quickly to the door, pushed away the two gangsters who were leaning against the door, and blocked the Wu family's door.
"Zhang Daqiang, don't bully others too much!"
"What's wrong with bullying you?" Zhang Daqiang spat and approached Qin Su, "Qin Su, don't think that relying on the Lin family to enter the martial arts gym and practicing for a few days will be great. You dare to stop the person our gang leader wants?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the two gangsters behind him also gathered around him.Staring at Qin Su with a fierce expression
Qin Su did not retreat. After this month of hard training, he was no longer the watchman that he was before when he could not even protect himself.
He looked at Zhang Daqiang coldly, "I say it again, take your people and get out!"
"Hey, you dare to be so harsh!" Zhang Daqiang instantly became angry, roared angrily, and hit Qin Su's face with a fist as big as a casserole.
He has brute strength and has been fighting in the streets all year round. His punches are fast, hard and windy.
Qin Su didn't move his feet and turned sideways to avoid his fist.
Before Zhang Daqiang could stop his momentum, he pushed his elbow hard against Zhang Daqiang's chest.
